title: Miband 4 - Bug Report: Color Artifacts in the BG Graph
symptom: Color artifacts appear in the BG graph on Miband 4, where the curve intersects the limit line and changes color, but the spline is not cut at the intersection, causing incorrect color regions.
cause: The issue is likely due to approximation in coordinate calculations causing point coordinates to shift by one pixel, leading to artifacts. It may be a chart library issue or a problem with the chart coordinates filler in xDrip.
fix: The developer switched the miband graph to dots representation instead of connected lines, making the bug less noticeable. No definitive fix was provided.
evidence_quote: In some cases, due to approximation in the coordinates calculations, the point coordinates can be shifted in one or another direction by one pixel which can lead to such artefacts.
